design.assignment_mechanism: Deterministic fixture assignment by ID prefix.
design.estimand: Synthetic average treatment effect on treated units in two post periods.
limitations: Synthetic identification evidence is not a real policy study.
design.no_anticipation_rationale: No shift is applied before period 4.
design.no_interference_rationale: Fixture unit outcomes are generated independently.
design.parallel_trends_rationale: Both fixture groups have identical pre-period slopes.

diagnostics.details: Small groups make unit-level uncertainty unstable.
diagnostics.method: Count unique units assigned to the treated group.

diagnostics.details: The design requires a contemporaneous comparison group.
diagnostics.method: Count unique units assigned to the never-treated comparison group.

diagnostics.details: Multiple pre-periods are required for observable trend diagnostics.
diagnostics.method: Count distinct periods strictly before intervention.

diagnostics.details: The declared post window must meet the configured evidence floor.
diagnostics.method: Count distinct periods at or after intervention.

diagnostics.details: The current estimator does not weight or impute unbalanced observations.
diagnostics.method: Compare each unit's period keys with the complete panel period set.

diagnostics.details: This is an observable pretrend diagnostic, not proof of counterfactual trends.
diagnostics.method: Unit-level pre-period OLS slopes; require the full two-sided confidence interval inside the declared practical-equivalence margin.

diagnostics.details: Placebo equivalence can reject obvious differential pre-movements but not latent bias.
diagnostics.method: Contrast each later pre-period with the first pre-period and require every full confidence interval inside the declared practical-equivalence margin.

interpretation: A treated-versus-comparison association was estimated, but it is not released as causal because at least one identification diagnostic failed.
limitations: Synthetic identification evidence is not a real policy study.
Passing observable diagnostics cannot prove parallel counterfactual trends, no anticipation, or no interference.
The estimator is an unadjusted two-group panel contrast with unit-level change variance.
The causal label applies only to the declared estimand, units, periods, and design.
